(Japanese: '''負けるが勝ち？''' ''To Lose is to Win?'') is the 54th chapter of the [[Pokémon RéBURST]] manga.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Ryouga]] and Danke heads off to the final round.
* The Pokémon contained in the [[Burst]] Heart in the tournament is revealed to be {{p|Throh}}, and Danke tries to use it.
* Danke wins the tournament, while Ryouga receives the Burst Heart as second prize.
* [[Sabin]] steals the Compass of Light along with the three Burst Hearts in it.
